Financial Advisory

Financial Planning & Advisory Grounded in Your Actual Numbers

Cash flow advisory, budgeting, forecasting and risk advisory built on your business's real financial data — not generic templates.

Overview

Advice Built on Your Books, Not Assumptions

Good financial advisory starts with accurate financial data — which is why our advisory work is closely tied to the accounting and reporting we already do for clients. We're not building recommendations on estimates; we're working from your actual numbers.

Whether you need help planning next year's budget or understanding what's driving a cash crunch, we translate the numbers into decisions you can act on.

What We Offer

Advisory Across Your Financial Lifecycle

📋

Financial Planning

Structured planning around your business goals, whether that's growth, stability, or preparing for a transition.

📊

Financial Analysis

Deep-dive analysis of your financial statements to identify trends, risks and opportunities.

💧

Cash Flow Advisory

Understanding what's driving cash flow gaps and building a plan to smooth out working capital pressure.

📝

Budgeting

Practical annual or quarterly budgets built from your historical numbers, not industry averages.

🔮

Financial Forecasting

Forward-looking projections to support planning decisions, funding conversations, or board reporting.

🛡️

Risk Advisory

Identification of financial risk areas — concentration risk, currency exposure, receivables risk — with mitigation guidance.

Who Needs This

Businesses Making Bigger Financial Decisions

  • Businesses experiencing unpredictable or tight cash flow
  • Companies planning a budget for the first time in a structured way
  • Businesses preparing for a funding round or loan application
  • Owners wanting an outside perspective on financial risk areas
  • Companies planning expansion, new hires, or capital expenditure

Benefits

What Good Advisory Changes

  • Clearer visibility into what's actually driving performance
  • Fewer surprises around cash flow and working capital
  • Financial plans grounded in real historical data
  • Better-prepared conversations with lenders and investors

Our Process

How We Approach Advisory Engagements

1. Financial Review

We review your current financial statements, cash flow and existing plans, if any.

2. Analysis

We identify the specific patterns, risks and opportunities relevant to your question.

3. Recommendations

We present findings and practical recommendations in plain language, not jargon.

4. Ongoing Support

For clients on retainer, we revisit the plan periodically as your numbers evolve.
